same_branch_indicators.same_accepted_seed: repeat solve keeps the same accepted seed family
same_branch_indicators.branch_jump_suspicion: continuity check remains free of branch-jump warnings
same_branch_indicators.repeat_drift_smoothness: repeat drift changes gradually across checked milestones
same_branch_indicators.repeat_vs_adjacent_step_ratio: repeat drift stays smaller than an ordinary adjacent continuation step

strict_reproducible.definition: same-load repeat solve closes under the inherited pilot-12 gate

near_reproducible.definition: same-load repeat solve closes under the relaxed fast-workflow gate and keeps the same accepted seed

promotion_policy.stronger_milestone: same-branch indicators stay strong, near_reproducible remains true, and a short confirm probe is recorded
promotion_policy.audited_ceiling: promotion above the current audited ceiling requires explicit milestone audit closure, including strict_reproducible
promotion_policy.operational_continuation_evidence: accepted fast-run continuation result without milestone-promotion closure
promotion_policy.open_policy_issue: the inherited strict thresholds may be too rigid for the newer fast continuation workflow; this is tracked explicitly as an audit-policy issue rather than treated as silent branch loss

status_convention.preferred_workflow: u_z-scaled continuation + auxiliary arc-like step adaptation
status_convention.barrier_reading: still numerical / conditioning-related, not a proven physical end of branch
